thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency > 5s for POST /v1/generate in prod-us-east-1 (detected 10m ago). Error rate rising to 6% 5xx; paging on-call. Auto-created incident channel: #inc-5012345678

Priya SRE: ack, I'm on it. seeing a sharp p95->p99 divergence on the dashboard. can someone confirm if a deploy went out ~10m ago?

Jordan (backend): I merged a canary 12m ago to change batching/kv-affinity heuristics (commit abcd1234). can confirm the change touched proxy->runtime routing.

Mateo (infra): telemetry shows an increase in gateway 502/504 from model-proxy to runtime pool runtime-45/runtime-46. connection resets and timeouts.

Priya SRE: ok, immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback canary, 2) route traffic away from runtime-45/46, 3) enable fallback model variant. what's fastest?

Jordan (backend): quickest is rollback the canary. I've got the previous deploy id. Runbook step: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/model-proxy -n prod --to-revision=3`

Amir (oncall): doing rollback now. will post progress.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by Amir (oncall) for deployment/model-proxy in prod. rolling back to revision 3.

Amir (oncall): executed: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/model-proxy -n prod --to-revision=3`

Amir (oncall): watching rollout... pods terminating and recreating.

Mateo (infra): health checks still flapping on old pods for a minute, giving 502s to gateway for short windows. coredb and infra look fine.

Priya SRE: looking at traces: the requests that timed out were the ones with seq_len > 1024 that hit runtime-45. seems KV-cache growth + new batching resulted in memory pressure and longer kernel selection.

Jordan (backend): hmm I changed the continuous-batching threshold in the canary to 128->256 to improve throughput. didn't anticipate tail latency on long sequences. rolling back that change now.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. New deployment replica set is stable (5/5) as of 00:04:25 UTC.

Priya SRE: perf graphs show p95 back near baseline and p99 dropping from ~7.2s -> ~1.1s within 90s of rollback. error rate down to 0.8%. good.

Sasha (product): what's customer impact? any big tenants affected? need to draft status update if mobile app users saw errors.

Mateo (infra): preliminary across the last 15m: ~2% of total requests returned 5xx during the window; mostly for long-sequence generative calls. tenant-wise: two customers (cust-phi, cust-gamma) show elevated errors (~1.5k failed reqs each).

Sasha (product): ok I'll coordinate with support for an incident banner and start a short post for status.redwood.ai. please add any suggested wording.

Priya SRE: suggested status blurb: "We experienced increased error rates (5xx/timeouts) for generative API calls in us-east-1 due to a recently deployed canary change to batching/routing. We rolled back the change; metrics are returning to normal. Investigating root cause and will follow up with a postmortem."

Sasha (product): +1. Support team, please triage the two affected customers and escalate if they have active incidents.

Jordan (backend): root-cause hypothesis: aggressive continuous-batching threshold combined with kv-cache growth caused runtime kernel path to choose an expensive quantized kernel for long seqs; that path interacts poorly with memory pressure and increases latency leading to upstream timeouts. need to validate with perf runbook against runtime-45 image.

Amir (oncall): starting a focused runbook check: `kubectl logs deployment/model-proxy -n prod --since=10m | grep -E "504|502|timeout|OOM" -n`

Amir (oncall): logs show repeated `gateway timeout to runtime-45 (504)` and `proxy: downstream connection reset` between 00:00:10 and 00:03:40 UTC.

Priya SRE: for short-term safeguards: 1) add canary gating for batching config; 2) revert default batching threshold in config-store; 3) add fallback route to model-light for requests > 1024 tokens in region. I can open the config change pull request.

Jordan (backend): I will open a PR to add gating and an integration test that simulates long-sequence tail-latency.

Sasha (product): Support notes for customer comms: emphasize rollback completed, majority of requests OK, two customers may see retries/failures during window; offer to follow up with logs and timeline.

Mateo (infra): recommend follow-up action: enable memory/cgroup monitoring on runtime pool and add an alert for kernel-selection time > 200ms. also increase canary cadence to test long-tail sequences during QA.

Priya SRE: creating incident ticket and linking this thread. owners: Jordan (backend) for fix/PR, Mateo (infra) for runtime metrics/alerts, Priya for postmortem. timeline: quick RCA + follow-up postmortem in 72h.

Sasha (product): noted. will schedule customer comms once we have a timeline and postmortem ETA.

Amir (oncall): handing off to night oncall. summary for next person: rollback completed, p99 stable ~1.1s, watch for any resurgence in 5xx from runtime-45/46 and watch support queues for two customers.

Amir (oncall): paging night oncall: @night-oncall please ack.

Priya SRE: leaving handoff notes in the incident ticket: commands run, rollback details (reverted commit abcd1234 -> previous 5678efgh), suggested mitigations and owners.

Jordan (backend): quick TODOs I will address in the PR: revert batching threshold change, add canary gating, add long-seq perf test, annotate commit with causal link.

Sasha (product): thanks everyone — good quick rollback. I'll draft the status page and coordinate with support.

incident-bot: Incident channel archived by Amir (oncall) at 00:10:05 UTC. Follow-up: incident-5012345678 created in incidents tracker for postmortem.

Priya SRE: final note — please add any additional context to the ticket; we'll meet for postmortem in 72h. :memo:
